_readme.what: Every hand-written page that carries Amazon elements (<BuyLink>, <AmazonLink>, <TopPick>, <AwardRow>/<AwardCard>, <StickyBuyBar>) in app/**/page.tsx, read from the working tree on Oct 20, 2026. The 86 data-driven North American guides carry no Amazon links and are not listed. Companion to data/amazon/reverse-engineering-2026-10-20.md.
_readme.window: canadianViews48d / canadianClicks48d = GA4, country Canada, Sep 2 to Oct 19, 2026 (48 days; the affiliate_click event only exists from Sep 2). Views = screenPageViews; clicks = affiliate_click events. GA4 sees roughly half of the clicks Amazon counts (1.88x in Sep 19 - Oct 18), so compare pages, do not read money from these. clicksPer1000Views is only given with 50+ views.
_readme.type: FINAL classification. Start from the owner's slug rule (product = best-/review/vs/versus/top-N/comparison/compared; remedy = how-to-get-rid/kill/repellent/repel/trap/spray; info = the rest, checked in that order). Then an 'info' slug that names a product (dust, bait, deterrent, swatter, sprinkler, encasement, dunks, bits, fogger, heater, kit, repeller, seal, compost-bin, magnet, diatomaceous, zapper, curtain, station, net, chimney-cap, sump-pump, clothing, refill, tubes, brush-cutter, tool, coils, screen, doktor-doom, thermacell, misting, fan, candles, aerator, leaf-blower, poison, powder, steamer, dehumidifier, gear, guard(s), sprayer, purifier) becomes 'product' (46 pages), and one with how-to-keep / how-to-prevent / how-to-stop / how-to-remove / proof / fix- / bite-treatment becomes 'remedy' (13 pages). slugRuleType keeps the owner's original rule for reference. Same rule as the report's tables, so the counts match it. Edge case: the six /pest-product-guides/ hubs are typed by the same slug rule (ant-control, bed-bug-control, cockroach-control and rodent-control come out 'info'); they are product-list hubs that already carry a Top Pick box and, since Oct 20, no display ads.
_readme.stickyBar: Props of the page's <StickyBuyBar> exactly as written in the source: quoted strings are given without their quotes, anything in braces is given with its braces (tag is always the raw expression, e.g. {AMZ_TAG}). amzTagDefinition is the right-hand side of the page's const AMZ_TAG as written. null = no sticky bar.
_readme.hasAwardRow: true when the page has <AwardRow> or <AwardCard> (no page has cards without a row).
_readme.screens: firstPickScreens = how many phone screens down the first picks box (Top Pick or award card) starts; firstLinkScreens = the same for the first Amazon link of any kind, sticky bar excluded. Measured at 375x812 on the local build of Oct 15 for the 40 busiest Amazon pages only; null = not measured. On a phone none of the 40 showed an Amazon link in the first screen.
_readme.inTest60: The 60 pages of the proposed (now skipped) first-screen Top Pick test: busiest product and remedy pages with a sticky bar and a set-up unchanged Sep 2 - Oct 19, excluding five pages being edited on Oct 20. test60Group = A (would have started with the box) or B.
